name: 65803 · Springfield, MO
findings: ZIP 65803 (Springfield) has 151 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 65803 (Springfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
